sections.titre: Here, nothing is wasted: it all feeds the hens
sections.texte:
Before it was a campsite, Clairac was a winegrowing estate. The big trees have had time to grow, the old house still watches over the place, and we simply opened 25 pitches in that setting.

Ecology is not a selling point for us: it is how we look after the estate every day.

items.texte: Stale bread and peelings go to the hens.
Green waste goes into the two compost bins.
Sorting (glass, plastic, metal, paper) is done along the path.
Drinking water is tested by an approved laboratory, and we use it sparingly: no car washing.

sections.alt: The estate's vines in front of the old house

sections.titre: With your tent, or with nothing at all

items.texte: Large, shaded and at least 5 metres apart, for tents, caravans or motorhomes. Hot showers, accessible facilities, Wi-Fi and a playground.
